items.title: Autonomy pivots to gas vehicles to keep the dream of car subscriptions alive
items.feed_excerpt: Scott Painter, founder of TrueCar, is still trying to build a business around vehicle subscriptions, where you can cancel at any time.

items.title: Sequoia doubles down on Cymphony as AI agents create new enterprise security risks
items.feed_excerpt: Cymphony was valued at more than $100 million in a $25 million Series A co-led by Sequoia and SMBC Fin Atlas Beyond Fund.

items.title: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
items.feed_excerpt: As it grapples with a bevy of lawsuits, Suno said its new model, Suno v6, is not trained using music it used to train previous versions of the AI model.

items.title: Apple shows off AirPods 5 with improved active noise cancellation
items.feed_excerpt: The AirPods 5 support better noise cancellation, Siri AI, and offer volume controls on the stem.

items.title: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone
items.feed_excerpt: The company also argued that its on-device models offer consumers more privacy.

items.title: Apple launches iPhone 18 Pro with upgraded camera
items.feed_excerpt: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro lineup upgrades the camera and comes in burgundy.

items.title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
items.feed_excerpt: Massachusetts has become the third state in as many months to slap new restrictions on data center development.

items.title: Apple’s new CEO is reviving a Steve Jobs strategy from 25 years ago
items.feed_excerpt: John Ternus made the case in his first keynote as Apple CEO that the iPhone isn't going anywhere.

items.title: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
items.feed_excerpt: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.

items.title: Everything Apple announced at its fall iPhone event, from the foldable iPhone Duo to an always-listening Apple Watch
items.feed_excerpt: The main event was the tech giant's highly anticipated first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.

items.title: There are new shiny iPhones, so Apple is making you pay more for older models
items.feed_excerpt: Apple is raising the price of its existing iPhone models by $100, including iPhone 16, iPhone 17, and iPhone Air.

items.title: Automattic’s board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence
items.feed_excerpt: Mullenweg said in a company Slack message that it was against his will.

items.title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
items.feed_excerpt: Paul Christiano, an influential AI researcher focused on alignment, is joining the OpenAI Foundation as a member of its board.
